summary: Two backcountry skiers attempting the Thunderbird Couloir on the west face of Grand Mesa; one triggered an avalanche and was carried 300-800 ft downslope through trees, breaking his femur and a second leg; Mesa County SAR, Powderhorn Ski Patrol and St. Mary's CareFlight responded and flew the injured skier out by helicopter.
location: Thunderbird Couloir, west face of Grand Mesa (above Rapid Creek near Palisade)
notes: Date 2010-03-17 stated in both the subject's first-person LOKI account and the Mesa County Hazard Mitigation Plan avalanche history; first known ski descent attempt of the Thunderbird Couloir. Mesa County's earliest indexed row.
wx_note: ERA5 archive 0.25° grid (Open-Meteo); coord basis: county (Colorado River, Mesa County, Colorado, United States)
